svg.text: L4 ENEMY + BOSS SILHOUETTE SHEET v1 · pure black = what reads at phone zoom
Extends L1 (#414 dungeon-look 03-enemy-look-sheet). Sizes = Config/Enemies.luau hitboxes (Echo PR #422). Shapes are original; NOT APPROVED.
leans forward · 3-spike back comb · leg gap
dashed = Config hitbox; mesh stays inside it
floats · flat ring · empty gap + shadow
dashed = Config hitbox; mesh stays inside it
widest · flat top · tall slab shield
dashed = Config hitbox; mesh stays inside it
dashed = Config hitbox; mesh stays inside it
PHONE ZOOM (390×844 portrait, default camera): mid range ≈ 10 px/stud, far rift ≈ 5 px/stud, near ≈ 14 px/stud
ELEMENT = trim only (spike tips, eye, ring, shield rim, halo). Body stays black/ink so shape reads first, color second.
Ember #E84814 · Frost #5CD6FF · Void #C04888 (outlines 45% to white per #438). Rarity colors (Rarities.COLOR) never go on enemies; they stay on loot motes.
